content:
IVX 112 SENIOR-DEVELOPER REPAIR + REAL QA CERTIFICATION

REPOSITORY
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

CURRENT HEAD
6dde6621ff97f4c2862072752049772229d7dd8b

CURRENT VERDICT
112/112 SENIOR-DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION: REJECTED

DO NOT CLAIM ANY AGENT IS 10/10 UNTIL THE REQUIREMENTS BELOW ARE PROVEN.

========================================================
P0 — FIX CURRENT BROKEN MAIN FIRST
========================================================

FILE:
backend/api/ivx-owner-auth.ts

CURRENT DEFECT:
The catch block contains duplicate declarations:

const message = ...
const message = ...

and duplicate console.error calls.

SOURCE COMMIT THAT INTRODUCED THE REGRESSION:
e8130157409251c5f670e37c2f26a16d86407fc8

REQUIRED FIX:
Leave ONE catch block, ONE `const message`, ONE logging call.

After fixing, REQUIRED proof:

1. backend TypeScript typecheck PASS
2. lint PASS
3. relevant auth unit tests PASS
4. full regression suite PASS
5. process startup PASS
6. Render deploy PASS
7. /health PASS
8. /version.commit == exact repaired GitHub SHA

No deploy/certification before those gates.

========================================================
P0 — FIX MAIN BRANCH QUALITY PROTECTION
========================================================

Current main protection has required status checks OFF.

Enable required checks for:

IVX CI
IVX QA Suite
IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
IVX Enterprise QA
IVX Render Live Certificate
IVX 112 Live AI Worker Certificate

No commit may be considered production-certified unless ALL required checks
pass on the SAME exact SHA.

========================================================
P0 — FIX IVX 112 HOURLY QUALITY AUDITOR
========================================================

Current bug:

quality_ok = ok && evidence_ok

This is NOT a senior quality gate.

Replace quality acceptance with actual verified fields.

For EVERY agent result require:

base requirements:
- runHttp == 200
- ok == true
- finalStatus == completed/success
- sourceReference != ""
- toolResultId != ""
- simulated == false
- fakeSuccess == false

WHEN CODE CHANGED:
- commitSha != ""
- changedFiles non-empty
- tests.executed == true
- tests.passed == true
- typecheck.executed == true
- typecheck.passed == true
- lint.executed == true
- lint.passed == true

WHEN SECURITY/AUTH/PAYMENTS CHANGED:
- securityReview.executed == true
- securityReview.passed == true
- negativeAuthTestsPassed == true where applicable
- no secret exposure
- no authorization regression

WHEN UI CHANGED:
- accessibility.executed == true
- accessibility.passed == true
- mobile smoke test passed
- no black screen
- no broken navigation
- loading/error/empty states verified

WHEN PERFORMANCE-SENSITIVE CODE CHANGED:
- performanceReview.executed == true
- performanceRegression == false

qualityOk MUST BE FALSE if any applicable requirement is missing.

Missing evidence = FAIL.
"Not reported" does NOT mean PASS.

========================================================
P0 — FIX 24x7 WATCHDOG FALSE POSITIVE
========================================================

Current certificate contains:

{ok:true,...}

This is forbidden.

Use:

ok =
  workerRunsAttempted == 112
  && workerRunsSucceeded == 112
  && workerRunsFailed == 0
  && workerRunsWithEvidence == 112
  && heartbeatStaleOver30m == 0
  && pausedOrDisabledAfterRecovery == 0

After writing the certificate:

test "$(jq -r '.ok' certificate.json)" = true

Workflow MUST exit non-zero otherwise.

========================================================
P0 — MAKE EACH OF THE 112 PROVE SENIOR-DEVELOPER QUALITY
========================================================

For Agent 001 through Agent 112 create a durable record:

qa/evidence/autonomous/agents/agent-001.json
...
qa/evidence/autonomous/agents/agent-112.json

EVERY record must contain:

agentNumber
agentId
agentName
role
taskId
taskType
gapId
startedAt
finishedAt
sourceSha
productionSha
sourceReference
toolResultId
commitSha
changedFiles
tests
typecheck
lint
securityReview
errorHandlingReview
performanceReview
accessibilityReview
deploymentEvidence
finalStatus
acceptedBySeniorGate
rejectionReasons

========================================================
SENIOR DEVELOPER HARD GATE PER AGENT
========================================================

An IA is NOT a Senior Developer 10/10 because:
- it exists
- it has a heartbeat
- it has a contract
- API returned ok=true
- it produced a sourceReference
- it generated a commit

Senior Developer PASS requires demonstrated behavior:

A. UNDERSTANDS THE TASK
- identifies root cause before editing
- identifies affected files
- identifies regression risk
- states acceptance criteria

B. CODE QUALITY
- minimal correct patch
- no duplication
- no dead code
- no hardcoded secrets
- no fake values
- no catch-all success
- no swallowed failures
- backward compatibility reviewed

C. TESTING
- relevant unit tests
- regression tests for fixed bug
- integration/E2E where applicable
- tests actually executed, not merely requested

D. STATIC QUALITY
- typecheck PASS
- lint PASS
- structure/build checks PASS

E. SECURITY
- authorization boundaries maintained
- secrets protected
- no unsafe logging of credentials/tokens
- negative tests for auth/payment/security changes

F. RELIABILITY
- timeouts
- retries only for retryable errors
- explicit failure states
- no infinite hangs
- no false 200/PASS responses

G. PERFORMANCE
- no significant regression
- no unbounded loops
- no unnecessary network calls
- no blocking critical path without reason

H. UI/UX WHEN APPLICABLE
- loading state
- timeout state
- retry state
- empty state
- offline/error state
- accessibility
- mobile layout
- no black screen
- navigation remains usable

I. DEPLOYMENT
- build succeeds
- process starts
- /health healthy
- /version exact SHA
- smoke tests pass on deployed version

J. EVIDENCE
- sourceReference
- toolResultId
- exact commitSha when code changed
- test output
- workflow/run ID
- exact timestamps

If ANY applicable item is missing:
acceptedBySeniorGate = false

========================================================
AGENT FAILURE CLASSIFICATION
========================================================

Each IA must have one exact status:

WORKING
PASS_SENIOR_GATE
FAIL_CODE
FAIL_TESTS
FAIL_TYPECHECK
FAIL_LINT
FAIL_SECURITY
FAIL_PERFORMANCE
FAIL_ACCESSIBILITY
FAIL_DEPLOYMENT
BLOCKED_AUTH
BLOCKED_API
BLOCKED_CONTRACT
BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY
NO_TASK
STALE
UNVERIFIED

Never return generic SUCCESS if a lower-level gate failed.

========================================================
112/112 FINAL CERTIFICATE
========================================================

Only create:

IVX-112-SENIOR-DEVELOPER-10OF10-CERTIFIED

when:

totalAgents == 112
started == 112
finished == 112
acceptedBySeniorGate == 112
failed == 0
blocked == 0
unverified == 0
agentsWithSourceReference == 112
agentsWithToolResultId == 112

AND all six exact-SHA workflows pass:

IVX CI
IVX QA Suite
IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
IVX Enterprise QA
IVX Render Live Certificate
IVX 112 Live AI Worker Certificate

AND:

production /health == healthy
production /version.commit == exact GitHub SHA

Anything else must produce:

IVX-112-SENIOR-DEVELOPER-NOT-CERTIFIED

with exact failed agent numbers and exact reasons.

========================================================
CRITICAL HONESTY RULE
========================================================

Configured != working.
Heartbeat != productive.
Commit != quality.
API ok != quality.
sourceReference != tests.
Historical certificate != current SHA.
Documentation certificate != deploy certificate.
Production on old SHA != current main certified.

NO FAKE PASS.
NO SIMULATED PASS.
NO UNVERIFIED PASS.
